move: portrait bento pops in, wipes uncover photos, ticker scrolls, wipes close
how: A 4:5 two-column by four-row bento grid (identity photo cell hidden, a years-stat cell with a horizontal ticker shown instead; the ticker scrolls x 0 to -520 linearly over the whole loop and the years counter runs 0 to 12) of white, black, yellow and blue cells plus three photo cells. All cells scale in from 0.85 and opacity 0 (expo.out 0.9s, 100ms stagger) at 0; a stage-coloured wipe plane over each photo cell collapses to scaleX 0 from the left (expo.inOut 0.9s, 150ms stagger) from 5%, revealing photos that slowly settle from scale 1.25 to 1.05 over 90% of the loop. Category chips drop in from y -30 with back.out(2), headings, labels, logo and dots lift in from y 26 (power3.out, 60ms stagger), a big stat counts 0 to 48 with expo.out over 1.6s from 10%, and three dots blink in sequence (opacity yoyo repeats). Mid-loop at 45% the photo cells lift 12px and scale 1.02 yoyo while their images drift (xPercent -6 / yPercent 5, sine.inOut 4s) and the stat cell rocks -2deg. At 81% the wipes close back over the photos from the right (expo.inOut) and at 89% the cells collapse to 0.85 and fade in reverse order.
adapt: Replace the studio name, tagline, chip labels, the two stat targets, ticker words, the two visible photos and the four brand colours. Keep the 0.9s expo.out pop at 100ms stagger, the 0.9s expo.inOut wipe and the linear ticker rate.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the 2x4 grid, cells, wipe planes and ticker inside el. animate(el, shot, D) returns the same timeline with labels at fractions of D; the ticker travel of -520px should be measured from the ticker content width so it stays seamless.
caveats: catalog says 20s but render.json duration is 10s
ticker is a fixed -520px slide, not a true seamless loop
from() tweens throughout; use immediateRender:false when built late
ends on an empty stage, not the first frame
